question: 已完成订单用户的购买品宽如何（品宽=用户购买的不同品类数的平均值，仅统计已完成订单）
gold_sql:
SELECT AVG(cnt) FROM (
    SELECT o.user_id, COUNT(DISTINCT c.category_id) AS cnt
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
    JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.category_id
    WHERE o.status = '已完成'
    GROUP BY o.user_id
)
raw_output:
SELECT AVG(DISTINCT_COUNT) AS avg_product_categories
FROM (
    SELECT user_id, COUNT(DISTINCT category_id) AS DISTINCT_COUNT
    FROM orders
    JOIN order_items ON orders.order_id = order_items.order_id
    JOIN products ON order_items.product_id = products.product_id
    WHERE orders.status = '已完成'
    GROUP BY user_id
);
pred_sql:
